messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 429 rate detected for tenant acme-corp in dedicated-us-west pool. 30% 429s over baseline in the last 5m. Pager: @oncall-sre. Impact: generation API (v1/chat) returning 429s.

oncall-sre: ack — pulling logs and routing to eng-runtime.

Alice SRE: I'm onboarding — can someone confirm whether this is tenant-specific quota or a shared pool enforcement?

Miguel Eng (eng-runtime): looking at gateway traces — responses include error 'quota_exceeded' with tenant_id=acme-corp. Pool metrics show spike in requests/second starting ~2024-07-28T14:05Z. Dedicated-us-west has headroom but per-tenant burst limit hit.

Jane CS: ACME Ops (on the line) reports they kicked off a large re-ingest at ~14:03 that fanouts to many prompts. They just confirmed it was unintentional replay. They asked if we can do an emergency lift while they kill the job.

Alice SRE: OK. Two paths: 1) temporary override of tenant quota (fast) 2) apply ingress mitigation (per-IP throttling) so other tenants not impacted. Need approvals for contract override. Jane, did ACME request this or agree to cost?

Jane CS: They approve emergency lift, PM confirmed verbally. Contract has emergency clause 3. CS authorizes a 1-hour lift. I can provide written confirmation in-thread: 'ACME PM Rachel L authorized emergency lift for 60 minutes to mitigate production outage.'

Sam Security: we need an audit record and TTL enforced on any override. Also ensure VPC controls are not bypassed. If we do an override, create a ticket and tag for security review.

oncall-sre: I can apply a temp override now. Suggest TTL 3600s and limit to tenant acme-corp only. Will also add a note referencing this thread.

Alice SRE: +1. Also let's white-list ACME's batch IPs in the balancer to reduce risk of collateral throttling (only if CS confirms IP list).

ACME Ops (customer): Confirming IP block 10.2.48.0/24 is our batch cluster. Please note we'll stop the job but may need lift while we drain queues.

oncall-sre: Applying override: rwctl quota set --tenant acme-corp --burst 20000 --ttl 3600 --note 'emergency lift - CS approved (Rachel L)'

```
# admin CLI
rwctl quota set --tenant acme-corp --burst 20000 --ttl 3600 --note 'emergency lift - CS approved'
```

oncall-sre: Override applied. override_id=ovr-20240728-1 TTL=3600. Added audit tag: incident/1719654321.

Miguel Eng (eng-runtime): seeing 429s drop from 30% -> 2% within 90s. Latency increased a bit (p50 +30ms) but CPU and GPU mem OK. Monitoring for error resurgence.

Jane CS: ACME Ops confirms they paused the replays. They're grateful. They will send formal written approval to billing within 2 hrs.

Sam Security: noted audit entry exists. Please ensure we capture exact change set for compliance. I'll file a short security blurb.

Alice SRE: While override buys time, let's add a defensive policy: immediate per-IP concurrency cap for 10.2.48.0/24 to avoid future fanout spikes. Miguel, can runtime apply a soft cap of 50 concurrent requests from that block?

Miguel Eng (eng-runtime): yes, can push a per-source concurrency rule to the L7 for that CIDR. Pushing now: set concurrency=50, queuing=enabled.

```
# balancer rule
source_cidr: 10.2.48.0/24
concurrency_limit: 50
queue_policy: fifo, max_queue=200
note: temporary after incident
```

Miguel Eng (eng-runtime): applied. Confirm: queue depth for acme-corp decreased as batch drains.

Alice SRE: Good. Can we also add a short-term increase to dedicated pool autoscale thresholds to avoid token-level slowdowns if they resume?

Miguel Eng (eng-runtime): bumped autoscale burst_policy multiplier x2 for 15m window. Will revert automatically.

oncall-sre: Monitoring for 30m. Will not extend override without written CS approval.

ACME Ops (customer): Thanks, looks stable on our end. We'll follow up with a post-incident report and change to our job schedule.

Alice SRE: 429s stable ~1% for last 10m, CPU/GPU within limits, no other tenants affected. Preparing incident notes.

Jane CS: I added customer confirmation and billing note to ticket INC-7539.

Sam Security: Security note created: SEC-2024-07-28-01 with audit link.

Alice SRE: Postmortem owners: Alice SRE (infra cause) and Miguel Eng (runtime). Action items: a) tighten default per-tenant burst modeling, b) add contractual clarity and CS playbook for emergency lifts, c) ensure auto-ttl and audit hooks are enforced.

oncall-sre: will close the pager after 45m if metrics hold.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Resolved — 429 rate restored to baseline. Root cause: customer-initiated replay causing tenant burst beyond configured per-tenant quota. Mitigation: temporary quota override, per-CIDR concurrency cap, autoscale bump. Postmortem assigned.

Alice SRE: closing thread. Will post postmortem doc link when ready. :thumbsup:

Jane CS: Thanks team. :heart:

ACME Ops (customer): Thank you all for the quick help.
